svg.title: The same street, twenty to seven
svg.desc: A steep Lisbon street before seven in the morning. The language school is dark except for one lit window on the second floor where a cleaner is working. Next door the cafe is open, its lights on, with three people standing at the counter.

g.text: TRAM
The same street, twenty to seven
Fourteen things to find. Two of the clocks do not agree, and one of them is wrong.
room 3 - dark, nobody until nine
the office - dark
one light - Dona Filipa
the door, and the sign on it
Escola Monte - closed
a bed, and nobody in it
the counter
Marco's cafe - open since half past six
the top of the street - dark
the cafe clock: twenty to seven
Marco - he opens at half past six
Ana - a coffee, standing up
a tram driver - he starts at seven
a nurse - she finishes at seven
the noticeboard, in the dark
the tram, empty, at the top
somebody waiting for the first tram
